page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.16xlarge is an arm64-based compute-optimized server instance powered by the Alibaba YiTian710 processor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores running at 2.75 GHz, with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 114685.05 and a strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 486.63 GB/sec. Single-core performance is moderate, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1815.1. Memory subsystem performance is notable, with a top-tier PassMark memory score of 3017.93 and strong cached small-block read bandwidth of 6476.63 GB/sec, though large-block read and write bandwidths remain in the average range.

The instance demonstrates strong capabilities in database and key-value store operations, achieving 94.6 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a strong PassMark database operations score of 27691.53. Given the arm64 architecture, dedicated core allocation, and 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio, this server offers a resource-dense profile for multi-threaded workloads. It is suitable for containerized microservices, multi-threaded data processing, web serving, and database operations that do not require local SSD storage or GPU acceleration.
